Mon petit,\n\nIci tout va. Le chauffage:
My boy,

All is well here. The heating works one hour in two, like everywhere. Your sister found oranges. Eat, sleep, don't get yourself noticed.

Your mother
Cher cousin,\n\nLes files d'attente comm:
Dear cousin,

The queues start at five. They say the power will come from your side this winter. If it's true, thank your neighbours for us. Here, nobody says thank you out loud.

Jan
Karel,\n\nLes pendules du ministère reta:
Karel,

The ministry clocks are all slow by the same minute. It is not a fault, it is a setting. You remember who taught us that.

Your old friend, V.
D. KRAL, chauffeur, Centrale thermique n: D. KRAL, stoker, Thermal Power Plant no. 3
Ma chérie,\n\nNe t'inquiète pas si je re:
My darling,

Don't worry if I come home late. The valve on boiler no. 2 has been whistling since September; they tell us to carry on and not talk about it. I only talk about it to you.

Dominik
Messieurs,\n\nCi-joint un poème intitulé:
Sirs,

Enclosed is a poem titled "November", in its original version, before correction. The author cannot sign. Do what you like with it, as long as someone reads it somewhere.
Bureau des requêtes, ministère de la Séc: Petitions Bureau, Ministry of National Security
Monsieur le Directeur,\n\nMon père, horl:
Director,

My father, a clockmaker, was summoned in 1971 and never came back. I was told he had emigrated. He would not have left his tools. I only ask you where he is buried.

Anna TOMAN
On ne nous montre que des façades fraîch: We are only shown freshly painted façades. The archives are "being filed". People smile for too long. I request permission to stay one more week.
Je signale que le locataire du deuxième: I report that the tenant on the second floor, left door, a ministry employee, comes home late and listens to foreign broadcasts. I am not signing: he works for you.
Mlle ZEMAN, dactylo, ministère de la Séc: Miss ZEMAN, typist, Ministry of National Security
Ma grande,\n\nCette semaine, on tape la:
Dear sister,

This week we type the same letter thirty times, changing only the names. My boss says it's for the commission. I don't know who will read it, or if anyone will.

Your sister, Ilona
Je signale que le locataire du deuxième: I report that the tenant on the second floor, left door, a ministry employee, comes home late and greets nobody. His light is on until three in the morning. A man with nothing to hide sleeps at night. I am not signing: he works for you.
